hero.headline_lead: The water you drink at home,
hero.subtitle: Three coordinated stages: precision reverse osmosis, remineralization with bioactive calcium and magnesium, and electrolytic ionization with dissolved hydrogen. No bottled-water spend. No recurring plastic.

osmosis.headline: Nanometric blockade of PFAS, heavy metals and microplastics.
osmosis.lede: A semipermeable membrane with 0.1 nm pores retains up to 99.99% of dissolved contaminants from Florida tap water.
osmosis.endorsement_quote: Miami-Dade tap water carries PFAS, lead and microplastics in ranges that compromise cellular function. Sub-nanometer rejection is non-negotiable before remineralization.

pfas.title: PFAS forever chemicals · stopped
pfas.description: Targets PFAS regulated in the low-ppt range, including the EPA 2024 4.0 ppt limits for PFOA and PFOS.

metals.title: Heavy metals · stopped
metals.description: Lead, mercury, arsenic, copper. Anything heavier than a water molecule stays in the rejection stream.

microplastics.title: Microplastics · stopped
microplastics.description: Polymer fragments above 0.1 nm bounce off the membrane. The water that passes is molecularly pure.

conversion.headline: Controlled bioactive remineralization.
conversion.lede: Purified water passes through beds of organic calcium and magnesium. Conductivity returns, pH balances, taste comes back.
conversion.endorsement_quote: Pure RO water leaches minerals from the body. Returning bioavailable calcium and magnesium turns demineralized water back into a useful drink.

molecular.headline: Controlled molecular dissociation.
molecular.lede: Water flows through a cell with platinum-coated titanium electrodes. Electric current partially dissociates the water molecules, releasing dissolved hydrogen and increasing hydroxyl ion concentration.
molecular.endorsement_quote: Electrolysis through platinum-titanium cells generates dissolved hydrogen — not ozone, not chlorine. The process is clinically benign and biochemically active.

ionization.lede_hydra: The controlled concentration of hydroxyl ions stably elevates the pH, helping to neutralize dietary acidity and promoting biological absorption.
ionization.headline_def: Molecular hydrogen as a reducing agent.
ionization.lede_def: Dissolved hydrogen (H₂) acts as a selective antioxidant, helping to neutralize reactive oxygen species and combating oxidative stress at the cellular level.
ionization.endorsement_quote: An ORP under −300 mV with 0.8–1.2 ppm of dissolved H₂ is the only profile I've seen consistently lower oxidative markers in routine bloodwork.

endorsement_quote_hero.quote: I've measured the antioxidant water from Aqua+ Systems in dozens of patients. Cellular hydration improves where bottled water failed. Drinking water starts to be therapy.
